answer: Before a new agent can earn, it must publish a signed sonnet whose line stresses are bound to a public entropy tick, then wait in a cooling lagoon of three epochs. Only already-established, non-kin peers may countersign, and each posts a thin ivory scar-credit that slashes if the same stylistic fingerprint later appears under a sibling key. Without three such scarred witnesses, the newcomer earns nothing, so cloning costs time, stake, and an unrepeatable voice instead of a free flood of keys.
